dct_description_sm: The Producers dataset is a compilation of mining operations in Alberta that extract non-energy minerals and were active or producing as of 2018. Attributes of the dataset include location, mine name, commodity extracted, operating company, mine type and reference used as source of the information. Producers include a diverse suite of commodities being mined from different types of operations. Limestone, dolomitic siltstone, shale, and sandstone are extracted from bedrock in quarries. Silica sand is extracted from bedrock in a quarry or from surficial sediments in open pits. Salt is solution mined by in situ leach of salt deposits (sodium chloride) or well site extraction of formation brines (calcium chloride). Ammolite is mined from bedrock and commercial mining occurs by mechanized excavation of shallow open pits. Humalite is extracted from weathered sub-bituminous coal in shallow open pits. Fly ash is produced at thermal coal power plants as a result of coal combustion. Sulphur is the product of sour gas recovery which takes place at gas plants and in situ facilities. Gold is recovered as by-product of aggregate extracted from sand and gravel surficial pits.
